nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Spanish-first synthetic patient bill page for the fixed BeneBot invoice, including secure-context messaging, a reconciled historical claim breakdown, and the conversation launcher. It explicitly separates the historical EOB from any current benefits lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: An async Next.js App Router page awaits dynamic route parameters and uses semantic, localized JSX with explicit accessibility labels.

nodes.name: BillPage
nodes.summary: Validates the demo invoice identifier and composes the patient-facing statement, historical claim breakdown, bilingual conversation experience, and source-distinction notice.

nodes.name: bill-breakdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Presents the deterministic Spanish-language arithmetic for Jane Doe's historical synthetic claim, including billed, discounted, allowed, insurer-paid, and patient-responsibility amounts. Source and date labels prevent the historical deductible from being mistaken for current eligibility.

nodes.name: BillBreakdown
nodes.summary: Renders the fixed, reconciled historical EOB line items as an accessible definition list with an emphasized $620 patient responsibility.

nodes.name: bill-experience.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the client-side transition from the bill into a secure BeneBot conversation by requesting a server-created session token and rendering the voice/text panel only after validation. It provides loading and Spanish error states while advertising English support and avoiding repeated identity collection.
nodes.languageNotes: The component keeps the untyped network response as unknown and narrows it with a dedicated TypeScript type guard before storing the session token.

nodes.name: BillExperience
nodes.summary: Creates a session through the BeneBot server route, validates the response, manages launch and error state, and swaps the launcher for the bilingual voice/text assistant panel.
